question:
Select the figure that will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e32982dc669f262148b1b8a1cfe4a818bdb4a1969bb6056ce065acf272ffb6d.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) Circle element ⇒ The number of circles are decreasing subsequently.

2) Line element ⇒ The number of lines are increasing subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/606fe06518dc80126fc1704f034672962af20f17f59cfb7b792b214daa2051f7.png] Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/363d66d633996fdc744921bf6011551506111b5fadb3e3bce85250341d035151.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
